answer: Spamming (sending messages too fast/repeatedly) isn't allowed — it's a Low level rule violation and can get you muted for 3–60 minutes if it adds up to enough points.
GIFs aren't allowed in chat. Any GIF you post gets auto-deleted immediately — no penalty, it's just removed.
Excessive pinging (like @everyone or tagging a bunch of people at once) isn't allowed — it's a Low level rule and can lead to a mute.
Links aren't allowed in chat. Any link you post gets auto-deleted immediately — no penalty, it's just removed.
NSFW and violent content are strictly not allowed (High level). This is taken seriously and can lead to longer mutes (10 minutes to 48 hours).
Penalties scale with rule level: Low < 15 pts = mute 3–60 min. Mid < 10 pts = mute 5–180 min. High < 5 pts = mute 10 min to 48 hours. Fewer points needed at higher severity means it escalates faster.
